formulas.noninterest_revenue: investment_banking_fees + principal_transactions + lending_deposit_fees + asset_management_fees + commissions_other_fees - investment_securities_losses + mortgage_fees + card_income + other_income
formulas.total_noninterest_expense: compensation_expense + occupancy_expense + tech_communications_equipment_expense + professional_outside_services + marketing_expense + other_expense

noninterest_revenue_yoy.description: Noninterest revenue YoY growth rate vs Q-4

net_interest_income_yoy.description: Net interest income YoY growth rate vs Q-4

provision_margin_delta_bps.description: Provision for credit losses as % of total net revenue, delta vs Q-4

compensation_expense_yoy.description: Compensation expense YoY growth rate vs Q-4

other_operating_expense_margin_delta_bps.description: Other operating expenses (excluding compensation) as % of total net revenue, delta vs Q-4

preferred_dividends_abs.description: preferred_dividends absolute dollar value for the target quarter (below-pretax line; predict directly, 0 if none expected).

tax_rate.description: Effective GAAP tax rate for the target quarter (decimal, e.g. 0.14 = 14%; may be negative in a benefit quarter). Choose from the GAAP historical anchors provided; a discrete tax item can push it far from any of them.

shares_abs.description: shares: diluted weighted-average share count for the target quarter (predict the count directly; drifts slowly with buybacks/issuance).
